title: Add a simple welcome screen to the Ask Fred chat page

requirements.text: Add a simple, user-friendly welcome/intro screen to the "Ask Fred" page (FredChatPage) that clearly explains what users can ask and provides a clear call-to-action to start chatting.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user opens the Ask Fred page, they see an intro/welcome view before the chat history (at least on first visit).

The welcome view includes English user-facing text that communicates: (1) Fred is a Clash Royale strategy helper, (2) example topics users can ask about (e.g., elixir, win conditions, deck archetypes, spell choices), and (3) a prominent action (e.g., "Start chatting") that takes the user into the chat UI.
After the user dismisses/starts the chat from the welcome view, the normal chat UI is shown and the input is focused.
The existing disclaimer remains visible and unchanged in meaning (still states Fred is offline/limited knowledge, informational only, not affiliated with Supercell, and no unblocked/bypass help).

requirements.text: Persist the Ask Fred welcome/intro screen dismissal so it does not reappear every time the user navigates away and back during typical use.
acceptanceCriteria: After the user starts/dismisses the welcome screen once, revisiting the Ask Fred page within the same browser session does not show the welcome screen again (chat UI appears directly).
Provide a simple way to re-open the intro (e.g., a small "About Fred" / "Show intro" action) without interfering with chat usage.

constraints: Do not add any network calls or external AI integrations for Fred; keep responses fully local and deterministic.
Do not implement or suggest any method to bypass network restrictions/paywalls/access controls or provide “unblocked” gameplay.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI sources) or other paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Changing the Fred knowledge base content/logic beyond what is required to support the welcome screen.
Adding user accounts, saving chat history to the backend, or any real-time/multiplayer functionality.
Redesigning global site navigation or changing existing pages beyond the Ask Fred page behavior.
